notes: Autopilot: a free chart watcher checks gold, GBPJPY and EURAUD at every 5-minute candle close and asks the brains only when it spots a setup (a breakout or a rejection at a key level, with the H1 trend), instead of every 15 minutes. At most 12 brain questions a day (auto_max_asks), one trade per pair and two at once (auto_max_open), news checked per pair's currencies. The test run now replays the watcher's past setups.
